exposure: Intra-partum cefazolin IV infusion (2g followed by 1g if delivery delayed >8h)
outcome: Umbilical cord plasma cefazolin concentrations (venous and arterial)
Maternal and neonatal target attainment (cefazolin concentration >1 mg/L for 60% of dosing interval)
cohort: The study participants were 24 healthy, GBS-colonized pregnant women aged 20-41 years, undergoing vaginal delivery at a gestational age of >=37 weeks.
finding: Standard pre-delivery maternal cefazolin dosing provided adequate target attainment in both maternal and umbilical cord plasma up to the time of delivery, with simulations showing adequate exposure for 12 hours following the first dose.
